label: lehome-groot-rollout-hf
on-start:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euxo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl docker.io pigz python3-pip
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
mkdir -p /etc/docker /workspace /var/log
cat >/etc/docker/daemon.json <<'JSON'
{"storage-driver":"overlay2","iptables":false,"ip6tables":false,"bridge":"none"}
JSON
(dockerd --iptables=false --ip6tables=false --bridge=none >>/var/log/dockerd.log 2>&1 &)
for i in $(seq 1 90); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo dockerd_failed; tail -n 200 /var/log/dockerd.log; exit 1; }
: "${HF_TOKEN:?HF_TOKEN required}"
IMAGE_TAG="${IMAGE_TAG:-ghcr.io/ryanjin333/lehome-rollout:latest}"
TARBALL=/workspace/lehome-rollout.tar.gz
if ! docker image inspect "$IMAGE_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [[ ! -s "$TARBALL" ]]; then
    pip3 install -q 'huggingface_hub[cli,hf_transfer]'
    HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER=1 HF_TOKEN="$HF_TOKEN" hf download ryanjin333/lehome-rollout-image lehome-rollout.tar.gz --repo-type dataset --local-dir /workspace
  fi
  pigz -dc "$TARBALL" | docker load
fi
docker image inspect "$IMAGE_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo IMAGE_LOAD_FAILED; docker images; exit 1; }
echo IMAGE_READY
docker run --rm --gpus all --privileged --network host --ipc=host --shm-size=16g \
  -v /workspace:/workspace \
  -e HF_TOKEN -e POLICY_REPO -e POLICY_REVISION -e POLICY_INCLUDE -e POLICY_MODEL_SUBDIR \
  -e BACKBONE_REPO -e BACKBONE_LOCAL_PATH -e GROOT_ACTION_HORIZON -e GARMENT_TYPES \
  -e NUM_EPISODES -e MAX_STEPS -e SAVE_VIDEO -e ROLLOUT_ROOT -e HF_HOME -e HF_HUB_CACHE \
  -e GROOT_POLICY_DEVICE -e PUSH_REPO \
  "$IMAGE_TAG" rollout
echo ROLLOUT_DONE
